name: I was like you
source:
You play as me. A different version of myself. I am a French teacher in a highschool in Tokyo, Japan. I settled in Japan to fulfill a dream. Everything seems fine, but one of my students is not feeling alright...

[From [url=https://fflo.itch.io/i-was-like-you-nanoreno2022]Itch.io[/url]]
